title: Retention Classes
description: Policy-oriented retention classes. They do not invent legal durations.

classes.label: Ephemeral
classes.description: Short-lived request/session processing data; retain only as operationally necessary.

classes.label: Operational
classes.description: Routine operational data retained under the Site/organization retention policy.

classes.label: Customer/Business Record
classes.description: Business-purpose records such as submissions/leads retained according to customer policy and obligations.

classes.label: Consent History
classes.description: Consent evidence/history retained according to applicable policy and evidence needs.

classes.label: Financial Record
classes.description: Transaction/payment records retained according to financial/accounting/provider policy; raw card data remains prohibited.

classes.label: Security/Audit
classes.description: Security and audit evidence retained according to operational/security policy.

classes.label: Credential Lifecycle
classes.description: Credential references and lifecycle metadata retained only while required for the authorized integration/security lifecycle.

classes.label: Content Lifecycle
classes.description: Content and publishing data retained according to content lifecycle/version policy.

classes.label: Legal Hold
classes.description: Exceptional retention override only when an authorized legal/operational hold exists; not an automatic default.
